assimilation.target_law: q_A(X_d | B_d, Y_d, Y_d-1, Y_d-2, masks, calendar, grid)
assimilation.background: exact previous-calendar-year SIC/SIT for d only
assimilation.observations: error-free OSSE values from archive reference on real SRAL geometry; three lags remain separate

dynamics.target_law: q_D(X_d+3, X_d+6, X_d+9 | X_d, F_d, masks, calendar, grid)
dynamics.initial_state: exact archive-reference SIC/SIT at d during training and oracle validation
dynamics.forcing_policy: d-only values with per-field finite masks and train-only normalization
dynamics.forcing_claim: signed archive grid-displacement components until sign/orientation/units audit passes

composition.sampling: one independent assimilation member followed by one joint dynamics trajectory per ensemble member

speed_admission.selection: non-dominated wall-time, examples/s and peak-memory candidates only

coarse_resolution_policy.reason: native archive is 311x225 padded to 320x256; changing canvas is not a resize implementation
requirements: coarse observation operator with representativeness error
